# ${module_id} - Independent verification asset construction

## Module contract and selection

@@SELECTION@@

Construct missing acceptance or regression assets independently from product implementation so the
product writer cannot silently define both behavior and its only oracle.

## Public interface and compatibility boundary

ROOT-fixed behavior/oracles + frozen base -> independent test-only assets and discovery proof. Concrete values and return targets belong to the owning step's configured instance. Private changes do not alter public semantics; update actual consumers for a real contract change.

## Rules, process, recipe actions, and allowed variations

P01–P15 own shared rules. Semantic choices in recipe verbs remain ROOT decisions; test_root only authors declared lane-local contracts. Workers mechanically execute supplied choices and return any missing meaning. Reviewer findings remain open within assigned boundaries. Each governing card cites all actions; member cards cite only their ordered subset. Parameters may select bounded source/test paths and optional profiles, never weaken acceptance or change authority.

| Order | Recipe action ID | Project-specific action/process | Allowed parameterization | Decision owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | M03-A1 | Confirm each requested asset closes a named verification gap; drop duplicates of trusted existing checks. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 2 | M03-A2 | Define scenario, trigger, expected behavior, oracle, and check selection before authoring. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 3 | M03-A3 | Assign one writer per shared asset; parallelize only disjoint conceptual outputs and paths. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 4 | M03-A4 | Author only verification assets. Do not change product behavior, policy, acceptance meaning, or locked configuration to make the asset pass. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 5 | M03-A5 | Run asset syntax/discovery/self-tests that do not consume prohibited real resources. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 6 | M03-A6 | Inspect the asset diff for oracle strength, coverage fidelity, ownership collisions, and scope. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 7 | M03-A7 | Publish one independently owned asset tip/result and the claims/check IDs it supplies. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |

- A semantic ambiguity in expected behavior returns to the decision owner, not to M03 invention.
- A strict test-only correction later returns to this same logical role/task through M05 and reruns
  only the known affected IDs after deterministic eligibility is proved. Reuse or hand off its
  invocation under the universal instance contract.
- A product defect discovered while authoring is a finding for M05; M03 does not repair product source.
